name: Speech synthesis (text to speech)
plain: Speaks text aloud with the device's voices; needs a prior interaction.
meaning: A site can read text out loud with built-in voices. The voice list differs by device, so it also hints at the OS, language packs and installed software.

access.prompt_ui: No prompt (needs a click, tap or keypress)
access.persistence: Voices list fixed per OS; queue lasts for the page
access.revocation: Nothing to revoke (no permission is stored)
access.iframe: Cross-origin iframes need allow="autoplay"-like activation in that frame

limits.headline: Can speak text out loud, after you have tapped on the page
limits.user_action: You tap Listen or Play aloud, or tap the page before it speaks.
can: Speak text out loud using voices on your device
Pause, resume or stop the voice
Pick a voice from the ones on your device
cannot: Speak the moment a page loads, before you have tapped or clicked
Record you or hear what you say
Use voices you do not have on your device

story.what_it_is: A page can read text out loud with your device's voices.

marketing.name: Web Speech API
marketing.pitch: MDN says speech synthesis lets pages read text aloud with the voices on your device.

story.for_you: You tap a Listen button and a voice reads an article or a language lesson. The browser blocks a page from talking before you have touched it.
story.for_makers: Makers use it for accessibility, language apps and hands free reading. It costs them nothing because the device does the voice work.

use_cases.example: A language app reads a Spanish word aloud so you can hear the accent.
A news site offers a Listen to this article button.
A screen reading tool speaks page text for people with low vision or dyslexia.
A browser game has a robot narrator reading dialog out loud.
A web note app reads your note back to you while you cook.
A children's reading site speaks each word as the child taps it.

risks: Voice list can identify a device

technical_bounds: Chrome 71 requires user activation on the page before speak() produces sound
Utterance rate 0.1 to 10, pitch 0 to 2, volume 0 to 1
Network voices in Chrome (Google voices) historically stop after about 15 s of speech (known issue)
Cannot record the output or pick voices not installed
Voice list and default voice leak OS and language (fingerprint)
